name: DTCC Payout Type 5 Code
definition: Specifies DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) defined payout types.

CAPG.name: Capital Gains
CAPG.definition: Distribution of earnings to shareholders categorised by the company as capital gains.

DIVI.name: Dividend
DIVI.definition: Distribution of earnings to shareholders categorised by company as dividend.

INTR.name: Interest
INTR.definition: Cash payment on a debt instrument calculated using the coupon rate, principal and period of time.

LTCG.name: Long Term Capital Gains
LTCG.definition: Distribution of earnings to shareholders categorised by the company as long-term capital gains.

PREM.name: Premium
PREM.definition: Cash payment that is categorised by the issuer as premium, usually offered as incentive for early participation in an offer.

PRPL.name: Principal
PRPL.definition: Cash payment on a debt instrument that represents a return of principal to the holder.

ROCA.name: Return Of Capital
ROCA.definition: Distribution that doesn't represent earnings and is categorised by the company as return of capital.

STCG.name: Short Term Capital Gains
STCG.definition: Distribution of earnings to shareholders categorised by the company as short-term capital gains.

TXCR.name: Tax Credit
TXCR.definition: Payout consisting of a tax credit.
